A growing list of readings, tools, and examples we draw on throughout the course.

## On agentic engineering

- Wes McKinney, [*"Vibe Coding Is Dangerous, Agentic Engineering Isn't"*](https://motherduck.com/blog/vibe-coding-dangerous-agentic-engineering-wes-mckinney/)
- Wes McKinney, [*"From Human Ergonomics to Agent Ergonomics"*](https://wesmckinney.com/blog/agent-ergonomics/)

## Tools we reference

- [Claude Code](https://www.claude.com/product/claude-code) — the agentic coding tool used throughout the course.
- **superpowers** — a spec-driven agentic skills framework (Skills week).
- **Roborev** — continuous AI code review that flags issues per commit (Debugging week).
- **Middleman** — a local dashboard to triage, review, and merge issues & PRs.
- **Agentsview** — an agent session viewer for reviewing what your agents did.
